name: Automatic Henrietta
original_name: オートマチック・アンリエッタ
source:
Henrietta awoke in a strange room with a strange clown doll.

She looked around and was even more shocked when she found a mirror.
Her reflection was some kind of living mannequin!

"Wha... what the... this is... what happened?"

Am I dreaming? she thought to herself... and from somewhere unknown, a strange voice began speaking.
It called itself Pierot, and before Henrietta could ask a question, it said:

"I have your body in custody. If you want it back, you must bring me all the valuables
you can possibly gather within 12 hours, after which your gears will stop."

And then the voice, with its hint of madness, disappeared.

Too bewildered to understand, but with no other choice, Henrietta began to search the room.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ091218.html/?locale=en_US]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
安莉艾塔在一个陌生的房间里醒来，身边有一个奇怪的丑陋玩偶。

她环顾四周，发现一面镜子时更加震惊了。镜中的倒影竟然是某种活着的人体模型！
“什……什么……这是……发生了什么？”

我在做梦吗？她心想……这时，从某个未知的地方传来了一个奇怪的声音。它自称皮埃罗，没等安莉艾塔提问就说道：

“你的身体在我这里保管着。如果想要回来，你必须在12小时内尽可能多地收集贵重物品带给我，之后你的齿轮就会停止转动。”

然后那个带着一丝疯狂的声音消失了。

虽然困惑不已，但别无选择，安莉艾塔开始搜寻房间。
